  • Constructor Details

    • ActivityBase

      public ActivityBase()
      Constructs a new activity. The initial start time will be set to Instant.now() and the end time will be equal to Instant.now() plus the value of DEFAULT_DURATION.
      Since:
      1.0

    • ActivityBase
